# Claims workflow PRD-Lite

## Business problem

Claims representatives spend 42 minutes reconciling eligibility across Brightree, a billing spreadsheet, and email. This causes a two-day delay for 30 percent of claims.

## Product direction

Provide one claims workspace that retrieves eligibility details and routes uncertain cases to manual review.

## Measurement

Success will be measured by faster claim handling and strong user adoption. Representatives may send uncertain cases for manual review.
